project.name: foodieapp
project.description: Aggregator POM for the FoodieApp microservices monorepo. This module is NOT part of the deployment path — each service under src/backend/* is built and deployed independently (its own pom.xml, own spring-boot-starter-parent, own mvnw, see render.yaml). This root pom exists purely so the whole repo can be opened as a single multi-module project in an IDE and so module-scoped mvn commands (e.g. mvn -pl module-name) can be run from the repo root during local development.
